MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 10

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

7. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
